models.model: EB 35% adjusted Potential + 5% adjusted actual PPG + 50% Starter + 10% Roster / NIG
models.selection: Original weekly-point prediction objective: minimum inner season CV RMSE across every remaining weekly score; outer test season absent from every upstream fit

potential_pairs.method: Same conditional empirical normalized PF/Potential gap and bye features; neighbor count retuned inside outer training data; no added bias correction

models.availability_model: Status-aware horizon/duration logistic; 2022-2025 MFL histories; known upcoming absence hard gate
models.potential_input: 35% adjusted Potential + 5% adjusted actual PPG + 50% Starter Strength + 10% Roster Strength
models.player_ability_update: fully refitted injury-aware weekly Sharks with shared position bias

potential_points.validation: Full 2026 retraining; neighbor count selected by held-out-season conditional-gap error

models.description: All ADL forecasts use one Empirical-Bayes scoring model. Team strength combines 35% availability-adjusted Potential, 5% adjusted actual PPG, 50% projected Starter Strength and 10% projected Roster Strength, with reliability and uncertainty learned together. Player forecasts use public Fantasy Sharks Week 1 priors updated by actual performances, calibrated weekly Fantasy Sharks projections, opponent strength and availability. Weekly scoring variation uses a Normal-inverse-Gaussian distribution learned from normalized scoring history beginning in 2018. Bonus Games, H2H, All-Play and playoff odds use the same simulated scores.
